_comment: Phase B.1 Skill engine acceptance set. Five (now six) skills that exercise every B.1+B.1.1 primitive end-to-end. Feed each `spec` block to the CreateSkillFromSpec macro (Authoring/CreateSkillFromSpec.js). Skills land in `Battle Director / <class> / <folder>` per the `class` + `folder` hints — run the folder-scaffold once per world before authoring. After creation, attach the returned UUID to a PC actor's `system.props.skill_active_list` so it shows up in the director's Skill picker.
_usage_inline: Open the CreateSkillFromSpec macro from the hotbar / world macros; paste ONE skill's `spec` block into the dialog; click Create. Repeat per skill.
_usage_headless: Via the test bridge runMacro endpoint: { kind: 'runMacro', args: { name: 'CreateSkillFromSpec', payload: { spec: {...} } } }. Returns { ok, uuid, id, name }.
_b1_coverage: formula resolver (skill-formulas.js): HP_DEALT, SL, HR/CRIT/FUMBLE/TOTAL (B.1.1), MP_DEALT (B.1.1)
action intent classifier (skill-intent.js): harmful vs aid
picker UI (skill-picker.js): cost gating + affordability + section grouping
Skill TARGET/COMPUTE/RESOLVE (state-handlers.js): roll + damage (HP and MP) + post_damage hooks + MDEF for spells (B.1.1)
action card (action-card.js): Skill kind dispatch + MP-damage labeling (B.1.1)

_shipped_in_b1_1.HR / CRIT / FUMBLE / TOTAL identifiers: Resolver reads from payload.hr/.isCrit/.isFumble/.total. Threaded from ar.roll into chain ctx payload (on_activate) and damagePayload (post_damage).
_shipped_in_b1_1.MP damage routing: type_damage: 'mp' burns current_mp instead of current_hp. NE-only affinity (no MP affinity sheet). damagePayload.valueType: 'mp' so MP_DEALT formulas resolve. Card shows MP-blue color + 'MP' element label + 'X MP' per-target unit.
_shipped_in_b1_1.Magic Defense routing for spells: skill_type === 'Spell' compares vs e.magicDefense; non-spell skills still compare vs e.defense.
_shipped_in_b1_1.Formula-based target count: skill_target accepts formulas after 'up to' / bare-N: 'Up to SL creatures', 'SL enemies', 'SL+1 allies' all evaluate via skill resolver (patch 1 from B.1.1 prep).

skills._test: Acceptance #1 — basic offensive spell. Exercises: cost parser, isCheck roll, HP damage commit, fire-affinity routing. No recipe.

props.description: You hurl a fireball. The target suffers HR+15 fire damage.

skills._test: Acceptance #2 — offensive spell with post-damage drain. Exercises: recipe `drain`, HP_DEALT formula identifier, post_damage_effect_ref hook firing per damaged target.

props.description: You steal another creature's life force. The target suffers HR+15 dark damage. Then you recover HP equal to half the HP loss inflicted.

skills._test: Acceptance #3 — single-target ally heal at RAW. Exercises: ally targeting (picker), recipe `heal_target`, grant effect_kind to action_targets, action_intent inference -> 'aid' from healing type_damage, isCheck=true (rolls INS+WLP), HR identifier in recipe_amount. Was flat-15 in B.1; B.1.1 added the HR identifier to the resolver + threads the cast's roll into ctx.payload, unlocking real HR+5 recovery.

props.description: You restore a target's vital energy. The target recovers HR+5 HP.

skills._test: Acceptance #6 — MP-burn spell (added B.1.1). Exercises: MP damage routing in Skill COMPUTE/RESOLVE (damage burns current_mp instead of current_hp), NE-only affinity for MP damage, Magic Defense routing (spell hits vs MDEF not DEF), HR identifier in damage_bonus.

props.description: You drain a creature's magical energy. The target loses HR+15 Mind Points.

skills._test: Acceptance #4 — apply_ae buff on ally. Exercises: apply_ae effect_kind, AE template lookup on the skill's own embedded effects, inline-ref sugar (target_ref: 'action_targets'). The skill carries the AE doc; the dispatcher clones it onto the target.

props.description: You wrap an ally in a protective aura. The target gains Resistance to physical damage until the end of the scene.

skills._test: Acceptance #5 — apply_ae mark on enemy. Exercises: apply_ae effect_kind targeting an enemy (action_targets resolves to the picker-selected enemy), AE template lookup. NOTE: Lock-On's downstream effect — allies get +SL Accuracy against the marked target — requires the passive layer (B.2). For B.1 we just verify the mark AE lands on the right target.

props.description: You mark a creature. Until the start of your next turn, your party gains +2 to actions targeting it (B.2 will wire the bonus).

_test_protocol: 1. Open Foundry world `fabula-ultima-2` with the director module loaded.
2. Run CreateSkillFromSpec macro for each `spec` block above. Each call returns a UUID like `Item.xxx`.

3. For each created skill UUID, edit a PC actor (e.g. Hina) and add the UUID to `system.props.skill_active_list` as an entry { uuid: <UUID>, name: <name> }. The actor sheet's Skills tab UI is the usual surface for this; alternatively use the test bridge `updateDocument` to write the props directly.
4. Start a Battle Director battle with that PC.
5. On the PC's turn, click the Skill command in TurnUI.
6. Verify the picker shows the test skills with the right cost badges.
- Ignis: pick, target an enemy, confirm. Verify the damage applies to the enemy with fire affinity. Verify caster MP -10.
- Drain Vigor: same as Ignis. Verify caster HP increased by half the damage dealt (post_damage hook fired correctly).
- Heal: pick, target an ally, confirm. Verify ally HP +15 (capped to max). Verify caster MP -10. No damage commit.
- Aura: pick, target an ally, confirm. Verify the Aura AE appears on the ally with physical Resistance.
- Lock-On: pick, target an enemy, confirm. Verify the Marked AE appears on the enemy (no other effects yet — B.2 wires the Accuracy bonus).
